2609.29131.title: Tag-Aware Structured Text Translation: Towards a Systematic Understanding
2609.29131.paper_summary: Internet texts are replete with format tags that carry structural, semantic, and functional meaning. Current large language model (LLM)-based translation systems struggle to balance translation fluency with tag fidelity when processing tagged text. We argue that resolving this tension requires a systematic approach at three interconnected levels: data synthesis, capability building, and multi-objective alignment. At the data level, we identify and formalize a fundamental trade-off between structural tag diversity and translation naturalness in synthetic data generation; existing methods optimize for one at the expense of the other. We propose a hybrid synthesis strategy (Hy-LST) combining LLM-based synthesis tag method and Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method to produce both diverse and natural tagged data. At the capability level, we decompose tag-aware translation into four sub-tasks of increasing difficulty in a multi-task supervised fine-tuning framework, enabling targeted capability acquisition and knowledge transfer. At the alignment level, we design three complementary reward functions under a group relative policy optimization framework, each targeting a distinct objective (fluency, tag fidelity, and tag-scoped translation quality), and show that joint optimization consistently outperforms single-reward alternatives. Experiments on six language directions (en2zh, en2ja, en2de, en2fr, en2ru, de2fr) demonstrate that each level contributes measurable improvements, and the complete system significantly outperforms existing methods. Qualitative analysis reveals specific error patterns and their mitigation after training with our method.
2609.29131.paper_summary_zh: 互聯網文本充滿了承載結構、語義和功能意義的格式標籤。當處理帶標籤的文本時，當前基於大型語言模型（LLM）的翻譯系統在翻譯流暢性和標籤忠實性之間難以取得平衡。我們認為，解決這一矛盾需要在三個相互關聯的層面上採取系統性的方法：數據合成、能力建設和多目標對齊。在數據層面，我們確定並正式化了在合成數據生成中結構標籤多樣性與翻譯自然性之間的基本權衡；現有方法在優化一者的同時以犧牲另一者為代價。我們提出了一種混合合成策略（Hy-LST），結合了基於LLM的合成標籤方法和兩階段LLM基於的合成標籤方法，以生成多樣且自然的帶標籤數據。在能力層面，我們將標籤感知翻譯分解為四個逐漸增加難度的子任務，在多任務監督微調框架中，使得有針對性的能力獲取和知識轉移成為可能。在對齊層面，我們在一個群體相對政策優化框架下設計了三個互補的獎勵函數，每個函數針對一個不同的目標（流暢性、標籤忠實性和標籤範圍翻譯質量），並顯示聯合優化始終優於單一獎勵的替代方案。在六個語言方向（en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr）上的實驗表明，每個層面都對可測量的改進有所貢獻，完整系統顯著優於現有方法。定性分析揭示了特定的錯誤模式及其在使用我們的方法訓練後的緩解情況。
